original_intent: Expose a flake.nix on master with packages.default so Nix packagers stop recomputing hash and cargoHash on every release (#1157), and cover the #647 contributor devshell case properly
derived_intent: Add flake.nix building decapod via rustPlatform importCargoLock over the committed Cargo.lock with the repo-pinned 1.96.1 toolchain, preserve devShells.default and devShells.ci from the agent-branch flake, commit flake.lock, add nix-flake.yml packaging-proof workflow, document Nix usage in README, ignore nix build symlinks
evidence: ./result/bin/decapod system version answers v0.95.1 from the nix-built binary
Cargo.lock pins 158 registry packages and zero git dependencies, so importCargoLock needs no outputHashes and no cargoHash exists anywhere in the flake

rusqlite bundled feature compiles SQLite from source, so packages.default needs no external C libraries beyond stdenv

unresolved_assumptions: macOS flake builds may interact with the darwin -fuse-ld=/usr/bin/ld rustflags in .cargo/config.toml under the Nix sandbox; the CI packaging proof covers Linux
